_comment: MCP configuration for the Graphiti MCP server (by Zep).
Graphiti builds temporal knowledge graphs — facts have timestamps
and can be invalidated over time. It uses Neo4j as its backend.
- add_episode: Add a fact/observation with a timestamp
- search: Semantic search over the knowledge graph
- get_episodes: Get facts for a time range
- invalidate_edge: Mark a fact as no longer true
Requires: Neo4j running + OpenAI API key (for embeddings)
Add to Claude Code via CLI:
claude mcp add graphiti -- python -m graphiti_mcp
